items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다...콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Report that Gucci cut a tote bag price from 4.45M to 3.5M won (about 21%), part of a broader first-in-a-decade luxury price retreat as consumer counts fell from 400M (2022) to 340M (2025); frames the move as an industry-wide acknowledgment that prices rose too far.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데...루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Gucci's Padlock Crystal bag dropped from EUR3,500 (July) to EUR2,450 (-30%) to win back middle-class buyers, while Louis Vuitton hesitates on cuts over brand-value concerns despite an 8% Q3 sales decline; piece frames contrasting strategic bets among luxury majors during a prolonged downturn.

items.title: 구찌는 가격 인하, 루이비통은 고수...명품업계의 딜레마
items.summary: Coverage of diverging pricing strategy between Gucci (cutting) and Louis Vuitton (holding) as the two largest Kering/LVMH houses respond differently to prolonged luxury demand slump; cites broader market contraction figures.

items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Vogue Korea covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, who wears the new Butterfly Special Collection inspired by her 1997 album motif; editorial/activation coverage of the brand's seasonal marketing push.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라... 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다

items.summary: Nate aggregator coverage/commentary celebrating Park Bo-gum's repeated luxury ambassador track record (Celine, now Gucci); framed with fan-favorable tone, representative of community-level reaction aggregation.

coverage.notes: Naver Cafe/Blog, DC Inside, FM Korea, 5channel, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin were searched via site:-scoped queries in ko/ja/zh but returned only old/evergreen product-review or off-topic content, not items within the 14-day freshness window - these channels are structurally under-indexed by public web search (platform content behind login/app-only). Numerous Weibo 'FAQ'-style finance-commentary posts recur with near-identical templated titles across many account handles (pattern: 'Demna首秀+关店X家+降价Y%, 3个维度说清+FAQ') - treated as bot/SEO-pattern content per source-pool-policy bot filter; only one representative instance was admitted.
